title: Synthesis and characterization of two self-assembled [Cu6Gd3] and [Cu5Dy2] complexes exhibiting magnetocaloric effect, slow relaxation of magnetization and anticancer activity

material_class.structural_family: nonanuclear Cu6Gd3 cluster with fused open-dicubane [Cu2Gd2O4Cl2] subunits

synthesis.procedure: Self-assembly of H2L with Cu(ClO4)2·6H2O, NEt3 and GdCl3·6H2O in MeOH/CHCl3 (2:1 v/v). The main text gives a stoichiometric equation (eqn 1) and notes that isolation of single crystals depends on the solvent mixture, amount of base and reactant molar ratio, but does not report laboratory masses, volumes or millimole amounts. Single crystals of 1 formed from the reaction mixture after four days. HO− and Cl− from solvent/salts support mineral-like core growth.

reagents.name: 2-((1-hydroxy-2-methylpropan-2-ylimino)methyl)-6-methoxyphenol
reagents.amount: stoichiometric 6 equivalents in eqn 1; no laboratory amount reported

reagents.name: copper(II) perchlorate hexahydrate
reagents.amount: stoichiometric 6 equivalents in eqn 1; no laboratory amount reported

reagents.name: gadolinium(III) chloride hexahydrate
reagents.amount: stoichiometric 3 equivalents in eqn 1; no laboratory amount reported

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Single crystals obtained after four days from the reaction mixture in MeOH–CHCl3; monoclinic P21/c. Unit cell contains two Cu6Gd3 units, eight lattice waters and two perchlorate anions.

properties.summary: Dc susceptibility shows χMT = 26.0 cm3 mol−1 K at 290 K (calc. 26.1), decreasing to 23.5 at 30 K and 8.0 at 2 K, indicating dominant antiferromagnetic coupling. Magnetization reaches 19.6 NμB at 2 K (below ~27 NμB expected for uncoupled/ferromagnetic ions). Magnetocaloric −ΔSm = 11.3 J kg−1 K−1 at 2 K for ΔH = 7 T.

measurements.name: magnetic entropy change −ΔSm
measurements.conditions: 2 K, ΔH = 7 T; isothermal magnetization 2–10 K, 0.05–7 T

source_locations.location: Experimental Section, General Procedure for Synthesizing 1–2 and the paragraph for complex 1

material_class.structural_family: heptanuclear Cu5Dy2 cluster with μ3-OH and μ-Cl bridges

synthesis.procedure: Same solvent/base protocol as 1 but using DyCl3·6H2O instead of GdCl3·6H2O in MeOH/CHCl3 (2:1 v/v) with H2L, Cu(ClO4)2·6H2O and NEt3. Eqn 2 gives a stoichiometric assembly equation without laboratory quantities. Block-shaped crystals isolated from the reaction mixture after one week (triclinic P-1).

reagents.name: 2-((1-hydroxy-2-methylpropan-2-ylimino)methyl)-6-methoxyphenol
reagents.amount: stoichiometric 4 equivalents in eqn 2; no laboratory amount reported

reagents.name: copper(II) perchlorate hexahydrate
reagents.amount: stoichiometric 5 equivalents in eqn 2; no laboratory amount reported

reagents.name: dysprosium(III) chloride hexahydrate
reagents.amount: stoichiometric 2 equivalents in eqn 2; no laboratory amount reported

reagents.name: triethylamine
reagents.role: base; also appears as NHEt3Cl lattice salt
reagents.amount: stoichiometric 2 equivalents in eqn 2; no laboratory amount reported

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Block-shaped crystals isolated from the reaction mixture after a week; triclinic P-1.

properties.summary: χMT = 30.2 cm3 mol−1 K at 290 K (calc. 30.4), falling to 26.3 at 26 K then rising to 45.9 at 2 K. Magnetization 12.5/12.3/11.9 NμB at 2/4/6 K. Zero-field ac susceptibility shows slow relaxation with Ueff = 15.8 K and τ0 = 9.8×10−7 s (Orbach/Arrhenius; α = 0.05–0.19 at 2–4 K).

measurements.name: effective energy barrier Ueff
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; ac 1.0–1488 Hz, 2–6 K; Arrhenius/Orbach fit

source_locations.location: Experimental Section, General Procedure for Synthesizing 1–2 and the paragraph for complex 2
